chunks: And with this chain of narration, he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
I did not marry off Fatima except for what Allah commanded me regarding her marriage.

key_terms.صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ: Peace be upon him and his family

ai.seo_question: Why did the Prophet marry off Fatima according to this hadith?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq records this tradition to emphasize that the marriage of Fatima al-Zahra (a.s.) was an act of divine obedience rather than mere social custom, underscoring the sacred status of the Ahl al-Bayt. This narration reinforces the Shia belief that key events in the Prophet's family life were guided by Allah's command, establishing their spiritual authority and legitimacy.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-226 According to the same documentation, God’s Prophet (S) said, “
I married off my daughter (the Blessed Lady) Fatima only by God’s order.”
